classes.name: EmployeeCSVImportAPI
classes.description: This class provides an API endpoint in OrangeHRM for importing employee data from CSV files. It handles validation of the uploaded attachment, manages the CSV import process through a dedicated service, and manages database transactions. It extends the Endpoint class and implements CollectionEndpoint interface, leveraging traits for ORM assistance.
